parsed.summary: Wacky Wheels Jackson is down 2027-03-26 to 2027-03-30. 9 production orders were moved, with 6 rescheduled at the same plant and 3 transferred to other plants because no same-plant slot was free. 36 dealers were notified once each for 79 customer orders, and 17 loaners were assigned.
parsed.decision_reason: Acted on a real incident of type plant_outage because the ids and dates resolved against the data, the rehearsal on the digital twin passed with zero failures, and the live baseline matched before the first write.
